walk.title: Solve it: the leaked key, and closing every open door
walk.sample: Leaked AI key sk-live-8f2a… · a former rider who can still edit Orders · Harvest Lane's tools

steps.say: Tolu's AI key is public and being used. In the first ten minutes, Nodo revokes it and pastes a new one into the single credential the automations use. Revoke first, investigate after.
show: Deleting the screenshot is not enough

steps.say: Then we find every other open door with an access register: one sheet listing every tool, who or what has access, at what level, and where its secret lives.
We build it with the rules from Module 0.4: one header row, one row per access. That makes it easy to filter by person when someone leaves.
show: One row = one person or app on one tool

steps.say: Every tool runs through one business account, not Tolu's personal one. Tolu owns the Orders sheet, with two-factor on.
The former rider is gone. Riders now only see a separate today's deliveries file, as viewers, with no customer data in it. That's least privilege.
The new AI key lives only in the Zapier connection, with a ten dollar monthly cap, so the next leak is a small problem instead of a four hundred dollar one.
Paystack is still being built, so Make holds the test secret key in its keychain. Only Tolu switches anything to live.
Now the one-page policy, short enough that staff actually read it. First, keys and passwords: keys live only in the platform or the password manager, never in chats, sheets or AI tools.
show: 1. Keys only in platform or password manager
2. Never in chats, sheets, docs, AI, screenshots

steps.say: Every provider gets a spending cap and an alert, and two-factor is on for email, automation tools, AI providers and banking.
show: 4. Monthly cap and alert on every provider

steps.say: Access goes to named people at the lowest level, and leavers lose it the same day. Customer data is collected only for orders, and only needed fields go to AI.
show: 6–8. Named people, same-day removal, quarterly review

steps.say: And the five words to remember if something leaks: revoke, replace, check usage, tell Tolu, fix the cause.

walk.end: One register, one page of rules: the next leak becomes a ten-minute fix instead of a four hundred dollar bill.
